Rendered once on every menu whose products carry Standard/Premium/Connoisseur tiers (auto-detected in src/model.py). The lead line is adaptable per menu via print_tiers_lead in menus.json.
print_tiers.heading: WHAT THE TIERS MEAN
print_tiers.lead: All tiers use the same container — the tier is the label:
tiers: regular white vinyl, colour print, no finish layers.
regular white vinyl, colour print, single spot-UV layer (gloss or matte) plus white-ink layer.
specialty vinyl (flaked / frosted / rainbow holographic), colour print, white layer, raised spot-UV (gloss or matte).
